predictions.quote: I've heard recently some people talking about that, you know, once Maduro goes out, because he will leave soon... the time of his impunity has ended. And I believe the regime is at its weakest position ever. They understand this is serious. There is a real threat and we are seeing defections, betrayals, and more and more people from within the regime reaching to us.
predictions.prediction: Nicolas Maduro will leave power soon (in the near term following this October 2025 interview), driven by mounting internal defections and international pressure, ending his regime in Venezuela.
